WORDS: Huh, What does this say on the button?
"Voice Change?"
That looks familiar!
I wonder what happens if I press it?
Wow! My voice is sounding different!
I can't wait to show it to everyone!
I'll be right back!
Ooh! Is that a voice changing button? I've gotta press it!
Nadia & Hot Pink Team, Are you guys excited to pick different voices?
Yes! We can't wait to sound like boys!
Red, What did Scratch Cat do?
He just got a new voice! I can give it a try!
Orange, Wanna do the same thing?
Yes!
Yellow, Do you agree?
I do agree, but look over there!
You must be the new character! Why don't you say hi?
Hello! I am a number one!
Lime, Are you excited to see the numbers show characters?
Yes but, look over there!
Look! My voice now sounds like a giant!
Cyan, Did Eight change her voice into a giant?
Yes! Let me give it a try!
Wow! My voice sounds like a giant too!
Blue, Do you really have to disagree?
Yes. Because I don't want to get another voice.
Me neither. I don't want to sound like a woman.
Lavender, Do you look sad?
Yes. Because I don't wanna get a new voice.
It's OKAY! I can get a new voice too.
Gray, Are you going to be furious?
